verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows bookings, card charges and receipts being gathered automatically into a single report tied to a trip itinerary. The closest items are a trip-scoped card that auto-deletes, transaction labels for project IDs, and a generic 'automated expense reporting' claim. These are adjacent features, not itinerary-linked trip reports.

support.subject: As an employee, a trip's expenses — bookings, cards, receipts — collect themselves into one itinerary-linked report
